outcome_evidence: The oven door is initially open in frame 0 in image and left_ego_image. The robot approaches the door through frames 1–55 and raises it toward the oven through frames 56–71. By frame 72 the door is upright against the oven front; it remains closed as the gripper withdraws through frame 96 in image and left_ego_image. No failed attempt or unintended displacement of surrounding objects is visible.
